project.title: Native encrypted backup-code login
project.goal: Use existing encrypted recovery codes exactly once as a native second factor with atomic session creation
project.scope: R04/R41 internal admitted-control recovery login only; no enrollment or endpoint authority

boundary.responsibility: Compose existing pending MFA and current encrypted pool with atomic one-time code/session writes
boundary.rationale: Existing enrolled users require backup-code recovery alongside TOTP
excludes: Enrollment, regeneration, password recovery, endpoints, actual handle/lifetime and cutover qualification

action.backup_login.description: Verify and consume current encrypted backup code with atomic native MFA/session completion

errors.refused: Opaque invalid_credentials, invalid_control, connection_refused, auth crypto/clock errors; known committed Rejected vs NotCommitted/OutcomeUnknown failures

preconditions: Runtime owns actual control handle/workspace lifetime and endpoint gates; no caller identity/time/key claims
Native replay protection requires authoritative native writer; no live dual writers
postconditions: One removed code and one fresh session with accepted recovery audit only after known commit
Known wrong-code failures commit existing shared budgets/audit; operational failure rolls back or reports unknown without cookies
external_effects: Declared canonical control verification/session/twoFactor/telemetry mutations and existing immutable lifecycle triggers
